examples: SART/PVT/CPT-family tasks for sustained attention questions
validity_constraints: ANT component difference scores have uneven reliability
overt gaze is not identical to covert attention
platform hold/dwell metrics are multiply determined
cores.platform_proxy_policy: early hold, dwell, completion and stopping behavior are weak-to-moderate behavioral proxies and cannot establish a specific attention mechanism alone

validity_constraints: trait scales do not directly measure momentary content-evoked curiosity
different instruments operationalize different curiosity facets
information seeking and information avoidance are not exact opposites
cores.platform_proxy_policy: profile visits, taps for more information, search actions and completion can contribute evidence but require competing explanations

validity_constraints: no single valid unitary measure of 'valuation + emotion'
affective arousal is not subjective value
physiology alone does not identify emotion or motive
appraisals and emotions are many-to-many
cores.platform_proxy_policy: likes, saves or watch time cannot identify value versus emotion without additional evidence

examples: Leach et al. multicomponent in-group identification model
AIQ-IV for broader identity orientation when appropriate
validity_constraints: identity is multidimensional
generic similarity/homophily is not identity
cross-cultural measurement invariance can be incomplete
global composite scores can obscure distinct components
cores.platform_proxy_policy: identity language/classifier outputs require validated coding and cannot establish identification strength alone

validity_constraints: source trust, source credibility and message credibility are distinct
perceived credibility is not factual accuracy
heuristic cues can shift perceived credibility
cores.platform_proxy_policy: engagement, following and repeat exposure must not be labeled trust without direct trust/credibility evidence

examples: modern online PSR multidimensional scale with intimacy, maintenance and real-life intention dimensions
validity_constraints: PSI ≠ PSR
familiarity ≠ closeness
parasocial ≠ reciprocal relationship
age and culture can moderate associations
cores.platform_proxy_policy: repeat engagement and returning viewers are weak relational proxies and can reflect utility, controversy or habit

examples: willingness-to-share only when direct behavior unavailable
validity_constraints: sharing behavior identifies transmission but not motive
stated willingness is not identical to later behavior
virality additionally depends on platform/network amplification
cores.platform_proxy_policy: share counts are direct behavior at aggregate level; motives require separate inference

validity_constraints: returning behavior ≠ habit
SRBAI ≠ complete habit construct
model-free RL ≠ habit by definition
repetition frequency must be interpreted with context and outcome sensitivity
cores.platform_proxy_policy: returning viewer rate and repeated engagement are weak recurrence outcomes, not habit diagnoses
